description: Create all hackathon submission documentation files (SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md, docs/VIDEO_SCRIPT.md, docs/SLIDE_OUTLINE.md, docs/AMD_USAGE.md) and update README.md with new sections
steps: Create docs/ directory at the repo root

Create SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md at the repo root with: (1) Guide to register for AMD AI Developer Program & lablab.ai, (2) How to get and configure Fireworks AI API key (reference .env.example), (3) How to record demo video - what to show, sequence, tips (reference demo/demo_script.py), (4) What to fill in the lablab.ai submission form, (5) Pre-submit checklist

Create docs/VIDEO_SCRIPT.md with detailed 3-5 minute video demo script: per-segment timing, what appears on screen (reference the app at localhost:8080, API at localhost:8000, evaluation_charts/), English narration text for international judges, notes for when to switch tabs/windows. Structure: Intro (30s), Problem statement (30s), Demo of prediction feature (60s), Demo of AI Advisor (45s), AMD integration showcase (45s), Technical architecture (30s), Closing/call-to-action (30s)

Create docs/SLIDE_OUTLINE.md with 10-slide presentation outline: content per slide, talking points, image references to evaluation_charts/ and references_images/ files. Slides should cover: Title, Problem, Solution, Demo screenshots, Tech Architecture, AMD Integration, ML Performance (reference evaluation charts), Market (reference tam_sam_som_diagram.png, market_validation_trends.png), Team, Call to Action

Create docs/AMD_USAGE.md with detailed technical document about AMD platform usage: (1) AMD Developer Cloud for training (reference train_on_amd_cloud.py - ROCm detection, MI210/MI250X support, GPU hist method), (2) Fireworks AI API on AMD hardware for LLM inference (reference app/services/advisor_service.py), (3) ROCm compatibility details (XGBoost device='cuda' via HIP, /opt/rocm detection), (4) Deployment considerations for AMD hardware

Update README.md: Add a 'Submission' section with links to all new docs (SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md, docs/VIDEO_SCRIPT.md, docs/SLIDE_OUTLINE.md, docs/AMD_USAGE.md). Add a more prominent 'AMD Platform Integration' section before the 'Quick Start' section that summarizes AMD usage (training on AMD Developer Cloud GPU, inference via Fireworks AI on AMD hardware, ROCm compatibility). Keep all existing content intact.
acceptance_criteria: SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md exists at repo root with all 5 sections (registration, API key, video recording, form submission, checklist)
docs/VIDEO_SCRIPT.md exists with timed segments totaling 3-5 minutes, English narration, and screen-switch notes
docs/SLIDE_OUTLINE.md exists with exactly 10 slides, each having content, talking points, and image references where applicable
docs/AMD_USAGE.md exists with 4 sections covering Developer Cloud, Fireworks AI, ROCm, and deployment
README.md has new 'Submission' section with working relative links to all docs
README.md has new 'AMD Platform Integration' section that is prominent (placed before Quick Start)
All existing README.md content remains intact and undamaged
All file path references in docs are correct relative to repo root (e.g., ai_backend/training/evaluation_charts/feature_importance.png)
verification: Verify SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md exists and is valid markdown
Verify docs/VIDEO_SCRIPT.md exists and contains timing markers
Verify docs/SLIDE_OUTLINE.md exists and has 10 slides referenced
Verify docs/AMD_USAGE.md exists and references train_on_amd_cloud.py
Verify README.md contains 'AMD Platform Integration' section and 'Submission' section
Verify all relative links in README.md point to files that exist
